8.8.6.2 Data Types
The mode declaration group EcuM_Mode represents the modes of the ECU State
Manager module that will be notified to the SW-Cs.
ModeDeclarationGroup EcuM_Mode {
{ STARTUP, RUN, POST_RUN, SLEEP, SHUTDOWN }
initialMode = STARTUP
};
